top_creatures.label: Layered-hit brute
top_creatures.why: Big, slow body whose record carries its own attack, defense and damage sound fields, so each monster sounds like its body
top_creatures.keep: big slow silhouette; per-record hit sound fields
top_creatures.change: our own sound set keyed to armour; moss and crystal body; ground-crack telegraph (not read in code)

top_creatures.label: Web-spinner brood
top_creatures.why: Two spider rows share one family, giant and poison variants with separate stats
top_creatures.keep: one family, several sizes and venoms
top_creatures.change: glowing venom sac instead of a palette swap; web-spit instead of a bite

top_creatures.label: Watcher orb
top_creatures.why: A floating single-eye silhouette is readable at distance
top_creatures.change: three smaller eyes in a ring; slow spin telegraph; no beam

top_creatures.label: Mana-drinking shade
top_creatures.why: A drain monster with its own class family, so the drain reads as a family trait
top_creatures.change: our own drain visual (a thread, not a glow); different body

top_creatures.label: Halo-marked boss
top_creatures.why: A few rows carry a boss halo effect, so a boss reads at distance through the halo, not size alone
top_creatures.change: our own halo shape and colour, tied to phase
top_creatures.ref: l2-unity/Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Meta/Npcgrp_Classic.txt deco_effect rows with the boss halo effect (7 rows, grep)

top_creatures.label: Crawling larva swarm
top_creatures.why: A larva family with its own class name; a cheap way to fill a corner with small threats
top_creatures.change: our own swarm cap and a burrow-out intro

top_creatures.label: Basilisk-type lizard
top_creatures.why: A low, long silhouette with one class family for the type
top_creatures.change: our own head and tail; stare telegraph in place of a gaze

top_creatures.label: Gaunt tempter spirit
top_creatures.why: A family that reads as a tempter, a different mood from the undead
top_creatures.change: our own look and voice line; no copied shape

looks.label: Skill effect as three data slots
looks.technique: Cast, shot and explosion lists per skill; each emitter has an attach node, multi-target and spawn-on-target flags, scale, and a simple variant class

looks.label: Homing bolt with ground miss
looks.technique: Lerp over wall-clock start and hit time, re-aimed at the live target each frame; a miss lands and skids with random spin; an arrow sticks into the root bone

looks.label: Layered hit sound
looks.technique: Damage sound on every non-miss hit; crit and soulshot layers on top; defense sound only when plain

looks.label: Hit particle tiers
looks.technique: Pool per soulshot grade and crit state; grade picks the colour tier

looks.label: Pawn light per effect
looks.technique: Optional light on a skill effect: type, effect type, colour string, radius, coordinate system

looks.label: Light LOD bands
looks.technique: Light enabled only inside squared-distance bands, shadows follow the band, refresh on a timer

looks.label: Cursor affordance
looks.technique: Hover cursor changes for attack, talk and pickup

looks.label: Two-state click marker
looks.technique: Base effect while travelling and reached effect on arrival, one marker

looks.label: Boss halo
looks.technique: Halo deco effect on a few boss rows

originals.name: Two-state waypoint
originals.idea: A destination marker with a travelling state and a reached state
originals.change: our own marker shape and colour

originals.name: Layered hit
originals.idea: Base hit sound always; crit and soulshot layers stacked on top; a defence cue only on a plain hit
originals.change: our own layers and sound set

originals.name: Homing bolt with ground miss
originals.idea: A bolt re-aims at the live target each frame; a miss lands and skids
originals.change: our own flight curve and skid; server keeps the hit authoritative (the client resolves the hit on arrival here, which must not carry over)

originals.name: Three-stage spell
originals.idea: Cast on the hand, a shot with a trail, an optional blast, each a data slot with a low-detail variant
originals.keep: three slots and a low-detail variant
originals.change: our own attach nodes and blast ring

originals.name: Distance-banded light
originals.idea: A spell light enabled only inside distance bands, refreshed on a timer

originals.name: Day-and-night ambience beds
originals.idea: Ambience beds per place split into day, night and always, with a distance cut and a random chance per loop
originals.keep: day, night and always split; distance cut
originals.change: our own clock from zone data and our own sound

originals.name: Augment shimmer
originals.idea: A weapon line carries augment codes, each a repeatable visual variant
originals.keep: a code per variant, a small set of variants
originals.change: our own codes, colours and shimmer on our own data

originals.name: Boss halo
originals.idea: A halo marks a boss row so it reads at distance
originals.change: our own halo tied to phase

defects: Hit particles dropped: ParticleManager.cs:179-197 dequeues a hit effect and recycles it only when expired; young ones are lost from tracking (fix: re-queue unexpired effects)
Null log read: ParticleManager.cs:184 reads GameObject.name before the null check (fix: check first)
Null re-queue to wrong queue: ParticleManager.cs:195 (fix: re-queue to the hit queue or drop)
Degrees passed to Mathf.Tan: CameraCollisionDetection.cs:30 and :53 (fix: half angle in radians)
Collision object is last hit, not nearest: CameraCollisionDetection.cs:89 (fix: keep nearest)
Mouse look per frame with no delta time: CameraController.cs:146 (fix: multiply by Time.deltaTime)
Zoom pull-in overshoots above about 13 fps: CameraController.cs:169 (fix: exponential step or clamp)
Music slot not stopped on new track: MusicManager.cs:43 (fix: stop old event)
Area music stay handler flips between equal-priority areas: MusicAreaTrigger.cs:92-94 (fix: switch on enter only)
Ambient loop stop uses a new enumerator: AmbientSoundEmitter.cs:80,165 (fix: keep the Coroutine handle)
Night check true in first quarter of day: WorldClock.cs:107 (fix: nightRatio > 0 only)
Projectile speed comment says 16, constant is 20: WorldCombat.cs:10,487 (fix: one value and one comment)
Impact sound skipped when no explosion list: WorldCombat.cs:217-220; skill 3 has empty ExplosionActions (3.json:5) (fix: play impact before the explosion check)
Bad pawn-light radius throws: EffectPawnLightParam.cs:58 (fix: log and skip that field)
Armour type does not reach defense sound: HumanoidAudioHandler.cs:55 TODO (fix: pick list by armour_type)
